name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 25 – Am 44
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 25a. Rejects the appropriations entered for support expenditure relating to the European Defence Fund, and the European Defence Industry Programme, in accordance with the corresponding budget amendments; stresses that security cannot be reduced to the continuous expansion of military capabilities or defence-industrial production; considers that an arms build-up risks fuelling escalation and an arms race without addressing the political, social, economic and environmental factors that drive conflicts; underlines that lasting security must be built through diplomacy, multilateralism, disarmament and arms-control efforts, mediation, conflict prevention, respect for international law and the peaceful settlement of disputes;
